- This file contains records that are Clean Alternative Fuel Vehicle Eligible and which have been registered no more than 250 times
- Information for multiple records are included in a single line as indicated by the variable descriptions below
- Dates are included as a standard structure (Year, Day-Of-Month Month-Name) but there is no informat for this structure
- Duplicate information such as Model Year, Make, Model, EV Type, Electric Range, & Base MSRP are stored in a separate table.

+ Variables are in the following order in *groups*
+ Each VIN is on a single line
+ For each VIN, 250 values of each recorded variable may appear
+ Records with missing values for *all* variables within a group should not exist.
+ Variables are in groups in the following order:
VIN,Zip Code,Legislative District,DOL Vehicle ID,2020 Census Tract,Registration Date,Electric Utility,Vehicle Location
